resources.string: Enter the PIN digits, then press and hold =.
Now enter the operator sequence (e.g. × × ÷ ÷), then press and hold =.
The PIN must be whole digits 0–9 only — no decimal point, operators, or functions. Type the digits, then press and hold =.
Add at least one operator (+ − × ÷ ^) after the digits, then press and hold =.
Only operators (+ − × ÷ ^) belong in the sequence. Press and hold = when the sequence is complete.
That didn\'t match your first entry. Enter the same digits and operator sequence both times.
